With reference to Commission's advertisement
No.PSC-R(All18/2O20 dated 12th June 2020 for recruitment of Generat Duty Medical
Officer, it is to inform that the reservation of post for PwD category was inadvertently
mentioned as " 396 of posts from 55 (fifty five) posts are reserved for persons with
Disabilities (PwD) candidates" it should be read as "3 posts out of 55 posts are
reserved for PwD candidates, i.e 1 post for Blindness or low vision, 1 post for Hearing
impaired and 1 post for Locomotive disability or Cerebral palsy,,.
